newsitem.title: USA: United Meridian Jade well tests 5,465 bopd.
newsitem.headline: United Meridian Jade well tests 5,465 bopd.

text.p: United Meridian Corp said on Thursday that its Jade 2 well offshore tested at 5,465 barrels of oil per day from the Jade sands in the Lower Qua Iboe formation offshore Equatorial Guinea in West Africa.
The well is about two-thirds of a mile north of the Jade 1 well, which tested at 2,000 barrels of oil per day, United Meridian said.
The Jade 1 well is located three miles southeast of Zafiro field, where the Zafiro 5 development well has come on stream producing 12,000 barrels of oil per day, the company said.
United Meridian, which holds a 25 percent stake in Block B offshore Equatorial Guinea, said nine other wells including the two Jade wells have been drilled in the area, but are not yet producing.
The field is currently producing about 40,000 barrels of oil per day from seven subsea wells, the company said.
Capacity is expected to reach 80,000 barrels of oil per day in the fourth quarter of 1997, the company said.
